Supercharger waitlist is here, and it’s a game changer.

Tesla just rolled it out to four different stations, and it finally gives owners clear guidance on where they stand in line. @tesla @tesla_na @elonmusk @MdeZegher @TeslaCharging 

No more guessing when it’s your turn.

The process is seamless. 

Join the waitlist, get real-time updates on how many cars are ahead and how many minutes until it’s your turn, and easily leave if you change your mind.

This is exactly what owners have been asking for to cut through the chaos at busy stations.

What’s new in FSD (Supervised) v14.3.3 (bundled as 2026.14.6.6 / 2026 Spring Update):
•  Actually Smart Summon max speed increased to 8 mph (13 km/h) — was 6 mph before.
•  New FSD distance tracker: Now shows total distance traveled without any interventions. The Self-Driving app also displays your longest intervention-free streak.
•  Improved handling of temporary system degradations.
•  Full merge with the 2026 Spring Update cabin features (Hey Grok voice assistant, rear display improvements, etc.).

SpaceX is building the infrastructure for humanity’s future in space.

From reusable rockets and Starlink satellites to Starship missions aimed at the Moon and Mars, the company keeps pushing aerospace further than anyone thought possible.

What once sounded impossible is becoming routine.

Video

Teslas continue to rank among the lowest-cost vehicles to maintain and repair.

With fewer moving parts, no oil changes and heavy use of software diagnostics, Tesla vehicles avoid many of the routine maintenance costs tied to traditional gas cars.

As EV adoption grows, lower long-term ownership costs are becoming one of Tesla’s biggest advantages.

Video

The Tesla Model 3 might be one of the best value cars on the market right now.

Strong performance, advanced software, low maintenance costs, access to the Supercharger network and constant over-the-air updates all packed into a relatively affordable EV.

For the price, it’s hard to find another car offering this much technology and capability in one package.
